name: cut-morph
title: CutMorph (state changes as film edits)
description: Opt-in match cuts on the platform's View Transitions: useCutMorph (interruption-safe, exactly-once updates in call order, never cancels transitions it does not own), CutMorphName for one named subject, and withCutMorphMode for React 19.3 <ViewTransition>. Stepped poses on twos, hard image swaps, no crossfades; reduced motion and still are instant cuts.
